title: Linq, which offers texting and calling infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $90M Series B led by a16z, following a $20M Series A in February (Harper Harwell/Birmingham Business Journal)
summary: Harper Harwell / Birmingham Business Journal: Linq, which offers texting and calling infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $90M Series B led by a16z, following a $20M Series A in February — Just a few months after a major Series A funding round, one of Birmingham's fastest-growing startups will receive another monumental funding infusion.
